claims.claim_text: Embedded release automation and security scanning into regulated modernization delivery paths, establishing an executive operating scope of governed platform leadership.
SVP Engineering agentic AI platform control-plane architecture centers on route policy dispatch and replay key audit manifest lineage for traceable execution.
Human override escalation paths reinforce the agentic control plane, preserving bounded oversight as execution scales.
Automated release pipelines and pipeline security controls produce repeatable deployment blueprints with measured security scanning coverage.
Policy-gated agent execution surfaces extend into the runtime layer, with tool sandbox egress policy controls bounding agent reach.
Platform productization and commercialization leadership generated $22M in IP-led platform revenue while scaling the engineering team from 8 to 28 specialists.
